name: eccos
description: Self-hostable, open-source WhatsApp gateway on the official Meta Cloud API. Runs as a Bun binary or entirely on Cloudflare Workers.
author: Santiago García Monsalve

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/gateway-contract && tsc --noEmit -p packages/console-contract && tsc --noEmit -p apps/mcp && tsc --noEmit -p packages/core && tsc --noEmit -p packages/auth-baseline && cd apps/gateway && wrangler types --strict-vars=false && tsc --noEmit && cd ../.. && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test:workers: bun run test:workers:gateway && bun run test:workers:mcp
scripts.test:all: bun run test && bun run test:workers
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run test:workers && bun run check:site && bun run check:docs && bun run check:dashboard
scripts.check:dashboard: bun run typecheck:dashboard && bun run test:dashboard && bun run build:dashboard
scripts.deploy: bun scripts/check-production-config.ts && cd apps/gateway && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.production.jsonc
scripts.check:docs: cd apps/docs && bun run check && bun run build
scripts.check:site: cd apps/site && bun run check && bun run build && cd ../.. && ./scripts/check-site-links.sh
scripts.check:site-links: cd apps/site && bun run build && cd ../.. && ./scripts/check-site-links.sh
